info.name: Food Delivery API
info.description:
# Food Delivery Microservices API

Official API Collection for the **Food Delivery Platform**.

---

## Microservices Architecture & Endpoints Overview

| Service | Base Route | Key Features |
|---|---|---|
| **Auth Service** | `/api/auth` | Register, Login, Profile, Refresh Token, Add Address, Logout |
| **Restaurant Service** | `/api/restaurants` | Create Restaurant, Add Menu Item, List Restaurants, Restaurant Details, Restaurant Menu |
| **Order Service** | `/api/order` | Place Order, Order Details, User Order History, Update Order Status |
| **Delivery Service** | `/api/delivery` | Courier Register/Login, Update Courier Status, Courier Performance, Available Orders, Accept Delivery, Update Delivery Status, Track Delivery |

---

## Dynamic Environment Variables
- `baseUrl`: `http://localhost:3000` (Gateway URL)
- `token`: Bearer access token for users/admins
- `refreshToken`: User refresh token
- `userId`: Authenticated user ID
- `courierToken`: Bearer access token for couriers
- `courierId`: Authenticated courier ID
- `restaurantId`: Created/selected restaurant ID
- `menuItemId`: Created/selected menu item ID
- `orderId`: Placed/selected order ID

item.description: Courier management, status updates, available delivery orders, tracking, and delivery lifecycle.

request.description:
### Courier Registration
Registers a new courier with vehicle details. Saves `courierToken` and `courierId`.

### Courier Login
Logs in a courier and saves `courierToken` and `courierId`.

### Update Courier Status
Sets the courier's availability (`available`, `busy`, `offline`) and appends a GPS point.

### Get Courier Performance
Admin endpoint: aggregated delivery stats for a courier.

### Get Available Delivery Orders
Courier endpoint: lists deliveries waiting for courier pickup.

### Accept Delivery Order
Courier claims an order. The atomic guard prevents double assignment.

### Update Delivery Status
Advances the delivery lifecycle (`assigned`, `picked_up`, `in_transit`, `delivered`, `failed`).

### Live Order Tracking
Fetches the live delivery status and courier info for an order.
